scientific_question: Does eliminating unrecorded stochastic WavLM backbone behavior rescue the otherwise identical fully frozen weighted-layer P13 recipe?

causal_precursor_audit.p13_runtime_behavior: model.train recursively left the fully frozen WavLM backbone in train mode
causal_precursor_audit.interpretation: P13 mixed frozen-feature transfer with stochastic backbone augmentation. Its terminal score cannot by itself isolate the quality of deterministic WavLM features.

locked_change.single_scientific_change_vs_p13: After the normal recursive model.train call, keep the fully frozen WavLM child in eval mode so LayerDrop, dropout and model-internal time masking are disabled while the layer weights and downstream heads remain trainable.

fold0_gate.passing_action: Permit complementary error analysis only; no automatic later fold or submission.
fold0_gate.failing_action: Close deterministic weighted-sum WavLM and proceed to separately preregistered L-adapter P14.
